summary: Full regression of the todos demo on desktop (1280x800) and mobile (390x844): smoke check plus all day-01 scenarios. Add, trim, empty/spaces rejection, long titles, bulk add, toggle done, delete, keyboard-only use, reload, and overflow checks all behaved as specified. No bugs found; known-bugs list was empty.

scenarios.title: Open app — heading, field, empty state, no console errors
scenarios.notes: Todos heading, New todo field, Add, No todos yet., Format version 1; 0 console errors on both viewports.

scenarios.title: Add todo with Add button
scenarios.notes: Walk the dog appears; field clears. Verified desktop and mobile.

scenarios.title: Add todo with Enter
scenarios.notes: Enter submits and clears the field on both viewports.

scenarios.title: Reject empty and spaces-only titles
scenarios.notes: Empty Add and spaces-only Enter add nothing.

scenarios.title: Trim surrounding spaces
scenarios.notes: "  Buy milk  " appears as Buy milk.

scenarios.title: 500-character title stays usable
scenarios.notes: Todo added; no horizontal overflow on desktop or mobile.

scenarios.title: Toggle done and undo
scenarios.notes: Checkbox + line-through when done; restores when undone.

scenarios.title: Delete middle todo
scenarios.notes: Only the targeted item is removed; order of others preserved.

scenarios.title: Delete all shows empty state
scenarios.notes: No todos yet. returns after clearing the list.

scenarios.title: Keyboard-only add, toggle, delete
scenarios.notes: Tab/Enter/Space reach field, Add, checkboxes, and Delete; flows work without mouse.

scenarios.title: Mobile viewport S2–S10, no overflow
scenarios.notes: 390x844: all flows pass; document scrollWidth equals clientWidth.

scenarios.title: Product smoke check both viewports
scenarios.notes: Load, add two, toggle, delete one, footer, keyboard usable; no console errors.
